editing: Full selected source intervals retain temporal order. Context runs at 4× or 8× and specified focus windows at 1×. Methods stay in a fixed row. Shared initial policies play together; later only the active method moves within each chapter. Waiting methods hold their first frame, and finished methods hold their final frame. Each evaluation names its method, iteration, and speed, then briefly holds the final frame with its outcome. Safety stops are labeled explicitly.
